requirements.statement: Implementation uses a clean worktree from the exact accepted v0.5-or-later base and preserves the current dirty canonical branch without reset, clean, rebase, or overwrite.
The successor adds no second workbench, broker service, provider client, credential store, daemon, durable database, or MCP inference back-channel.

Cutover planning is read-only/query-only, emits one canonical plan on stdout only, executes no WAL checkpoint or other mutation, and binds exact owner, DB/WAL/SHM, schema/state, candidate, intent, profile output, authority-history tip/current pointer, generation, and snapshot intent.

Cutover apply/abort/reconcile/restore and runtime-initialize mutations hold the stable runtime-home lock exclusively from final precheck through their named strict prepared-marker, DB/profile/immutable-history/current/terminal-marker writes; supervisor holds it shared for life plus predecessor owner identity. Runtime initialize creates no separate epoch or reconcile namespace.

Only an explicit exclusive-lock mutator may use the SQLite backup API; plan only observes DB/WAL/SHM. Backup/restore bind hashes, fsync, integrity/FK, sidecar disposition, and zero-source-mutation failure evidence.
Registry-v6 DDL and its exact migration attestation commit in one SQLite transaction after an immutable external prepared marker.

runtime initialize idempotently creates or recognizes only canonical empty v5 and then stops. Caught pre/post-commit faults converge, but abrupt process-loss WAL/SHM residue is explicitly not crash-convergent: it fails closed as UNINITIALIZED_RUNTIME_RESIDUE with no delete/checkpoint/adoption/retry authority. The operator separately materializes an ordinary cutover plan; apply/reconcile reruns converge only through that plan and ordinary markers, and reconcile never silently applies or aborts a prepared old DB.

Every snapshot/prepared/DB/profile/immutable-history/current-pointer/terminal-marker and restore-replacement crash boundary has an explicit exact-input cutover/restore classification and write set; ambiguity or changed inputs preserve recovery-required without blind replay.

Restore is allowed only before any committed v6 attestation, immutable activation-history record, runtime generation, workbench admission or v6 write. It requires an exact original cutover_aborted or cutover_recovery_required terminal marker and a later restore_committed receipt/marker that digest-binds and terminally resolves that cutover without rewriting either epoch.

Cutover and restore use strict cycle-free plan→prepared→transaction/receipt→terminal authority, including exact snapshot-before-prepared adoption. Restore preparation and receipt require the original cutover terminal-marker digest; only one exact cutover_recovery_required→restore_committed pair closes a pre-frontier recovery epoch. Missing, duplicate, mismatched or recovery-required restore successors remain startup-blocking.

All fourteen strict operator/profile/evaluation schemas have complete required-property, nullability, bound, cross-field and self-digest authority; marker construction is acyclic, activation/grant/readback state is total, and candidate/route/recovery inputs retain canonical versions, frozen six-method/evidence domains and v6-compatible backends with no secret.

A side-effect-free shared-lock preflight validates final profile, attestation, complete unbranched activation history, committed markers, exact derived current pointer, and all factories before host construction/runtime-generation allocation; final recheck gates Ready on v6.

Per-method capability truth is derived from exact instantiated current-generation adapters and frozen v8 contracts: native/caller rows may be admission-usable, exact reference rows are configured/reference-only/unknown but never usable, and stale or missing rows are unconfigured; no input boolean creates readiness.

Capability rows derive from package-owned immutable factories bound to implementation, manifest, generation, method contract, backend kind, frozen capability evidence tier and v6 owner compatibility; evaluator route/usage/visibility classification has one separate strict owner and cannot be upgraded from capability metadata.

The supervisor derives a strict server-side grant-set policy only after activation/factory verification; the frozen grant_ids array resolves one coherent current issued-record set binding exact principal/session, budgets/TTL/deadline, runtime/activation/profile/history-tip/capability/route/grant-set digests, and client context is never authority.
Profile activation alone creates no operation and performs no physical inference.

Grant resolution rejects missing/revoked/expired/mixed-set/duplicate-capability records, serializes every authority-denied outcome as frozen-v8 GRANT_DENIED, enforces a grant-policy TTL minimum of 1000 ms, and applies authority-before-availability precedence with zero operation/provider side effect. No non-recomputable internal-record-shape digest is published.

Every caller-delegated root-planner phase uses one durable model.request ticket with exact {kind=planner,phase,step_index}, SQL-null cell authority, unique predecessor operation event, and the frozen-v6 cell-free successor-outbox CAS; operation/request/route/directive identities stay in existing owners and synchronous call count is zero.

Every caller-delegated workbench execution requires frozen-v8 start_only=true. start_only=false always rejects before operation creation; v1 defines no duplex-driver exception and changes no frozen request schema.

External planner wait releases the execution-attempt lease, stays accepted/waiting_external, and resumes only through exact pending-to-prepared or fenced prepared-to-prepared takeover followed by atomic prepared-to-consumed plus one valid directive/correction/certain terminal projection; outcome unknown stays unconsumed and planner never accesses cell-bound authority/rebind tables.

Only reconciler-settled route, usage, physical-attempt, response-contract, budget and fence evidence can authorize a planner outcome. Frozen caller-work states settled_success, settled_failure and cancelled_certain alone create successor outbox authority; cancelled_before_send uses outer cancellation/finalization, while cancel_requested, outcome_unknown and quarantined have no outbox and remain reconciliation-owned. Absent usage dimensions remain null.
Recovery planning starts from a certain pre-cell checkpoint and cannot automatically replay arbitrary Python or the failed source digest.

Planner settlement maps every valid directive, bounded correction, settled_failure, cancelled_certain, before-send cancellation, deadline and possibly-sent uncertainty to one exact frozen consume/no-consume rule. Only settled_success, settled_failure and cancelled_certain may prepare/consume a successor outbox; no blind resend or synthetic settlement digest is permitted.

Required methods are a pure pre-operation function of normalized job/profile planner mode, frozen budgets/features, the effective capability union from a coherent server-validated grant_ids set, and matching package-owned model.request/method factories; the full separately-profiled native/caller cross-product is mandatory T2 release evidence.

Unavailable optional methods are omitted and fail certain before send; feature-implied ungranted or retired/stale factory authority serializes as frozen-v8 GRANT_DENIED, while a valid current-grant same-generation instantiated-adapter health loss is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE, with mandatory discriminating evidence.

AAR/Prime qualification uses one strict evaluator evidence-classification record per arm/attempt; provider, model, reasoning, fallback and cache each retain their own attested/observed/requested_only/contradicted tier, and Prime alias normalization never exceeds native evidence.

Qualification joins exact operation/owner/suspension/ticket/claim/physical-attempt/request/route/response/time/adapter fields and deterministically derives per-component tiers plus aar_live_qualified/prime_live_qualified/insufficient/contradicted with source digests; capability evidence cannot upgrade it.

Usage classification deterministically projects request_receipt/session_aggregate/partial_events/unavailable and complete/aggregate_only/unknown; request_receipt requires provider-reported rows for every physical attempt, exact arithmetic and no zero imputation.

Send-start, claim, physical-attempt, receipt, retry/recovery, deadline and reconciliation lineage prevents duplicate or blind replay spend; possibly-sent outcome_unknown/quarantined work never becomes a certain deadline terminal without authoritative evidence.

Frozen v7 capability bytes, v8 38-tool names/order/schemas, caller-work owner/request bytes, operation-event/attempt/lease/dispatch owners, and registry-v6 nullable suspension, successor-outbox, cell-only attempt-authority/rebind-transfer DDL remain byte-identical while planner uses only the existing cell-free owners.

Without an activation-profile path, the successor preserves v0.5 startup and publishes only truthful unconfigured/reference capability rows with no mutation grants or migration. A supplied-but-absent, malformed, stale or binding-invalid profile fails before host construction, runtime-generation allocation, listener, Ready, grant or operation.

One explicit aar-admin surface separates stdout-only zero-write/zero-checkpoint plan/status/verify from explicit apply/abort/reconcile/restore/runtime-initialize mutations, names every mutator write set, and never silently owns service stop/start.

Activation intent/final profile, plans, receipts, logs, DB rows, package assets, and evidence contain no provider credential or semantic command/endpoint/import field; allowed identifier values are never expanded, resolved, imported, executed, or content-classified as credentials.

One immutable candidate passes every mandatory T0-T3 row, including all fourteen schema fixtures, crash-convergent cell-free planner outcomes, append-only history/reconcile, grant_ids resolution and all admission cross-products, plus exact-wheel preserved-v5 and empty-runtime-v5-bootstrap-to-v6 hosts and independent current-byte review before implementation_verified.

T4 live_qualified requires AAR attested request-level route/usage and Prime stock-native observation of effective canonical provider/model/fallback/cache with no contradiction; Prime reasoning may remain explicitly requested_only with null effective reasoning when stock output exposes no effort field, while requested_treatment_qualified alone cannot admit T5.

No paired instrumentation block, physical attempt, machine stop action, rerun, score, comparison, winner or expansion is admitted by v1/0.6.0. Future paired protocol categories are planning bytes only and require a separately reviewed launcher-authority SDD before they can become executable authority.

A strict paired-evaluation-admission document binds live-qualified classifications and exact candidate/profile/alias/case/protocol/budget/stop-matrix bytes, explicit operator planning authority and arm order. It is planning evidence only: it allocates no physical attempt, proves no request count and cannot authorize T5 spend in v1/0.6.0.
Specification, implementation, verification, live qualification, and benchmark-ready statuses remain separate and cannot be promoted by inference.
